gaps.explanation: Report itself does not add up. The whole -145,327 is detail[51], Capital Projects Fund 'Receipts' 145,327, printed in the Actual column of the Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Major Funds (trimmed p8, printed p22). The same schedule's own arithmetic treats receipts as 0: Excess (Deficiency) (17,224) = 0 - Disbursements 17,224; Net change (4,911) = (17,224) + Transfers in 12,313; 765,190 - 4,911 = 760,279. The governmental funds statement (trimmed p4, printed p8) Capital Projects Fund column TOTAL RECEIPTS is '-'; statement Total receipts 7,001,690 = detail 7,147,017 - 145,327. The cell is printed, so it stays (as-printed rule; not a duplicate of another detail line). Nothing is missing: every other fund column ties (General 4,051,046 p5; Road 877,591, Inheritance 112,211, Road Sinking 110,689 p7; COVID ARPA 5,543, Transit 1,472,320 p8; Nonmajor 372,290 = combining pp12-14). Other financing: detail Transfers In 1,550,885 and Transfers Out (1,550,885) equal the p4 statement fund-column rows (General 375,794/(963,946), Road 550,000/(50,000), Inheritance (515,000), Road Sinking 50,000, Transit 480,000, Capital Projects 12,313, Nonmajor 82,778/(21,939)); no bond proceeds or other financing rows are printed (Road Sinking 'Proceeds from Sale of Bonds' is '-').
